exposure_contract.joint_lr: baseline factor at floor(completed_updates/4), repeated across each balanced block

matching_scope: Matched counts and nominal pre-update LR exposure, not identical sampled task0 frame sequence or gradient trajectory
verified_implementation_constraint: Existing exposure_matched_train_wrapper_v1.py pins complete historical config hash/name, cfg.seed1000 and sampler seed1000. Editing only a config seed cannot produce a valid fresh-seed run.
required_new_version: Independent hash-pinned wrapper/config pair must register model/trainer seed and homogeneous sampler seed together; preserve v1 unchanged. Single original loader and joint balanced sampler remain different algorithms and must be explicitly reported.
decision: Do not launch historical wrapper with new config or bypass its guards. No wrapper or config modification until bounded fresh-seed execution protocol is registered.
